purpose: Inspect all eight original P7 criteria in three dimensions while retaining exact source values and incomplete research obligations.
authorization: User requested 3D visualizations for every P7 item within the existing MathScope site. This is an additive workspace feature using the existing visual design.

sourcePolicy.archive: Compact display extracts from the seven source-bound attempt2 execution records, with original GitHub record links. These are saved examples, not fresh live results.
sourcePolicy.live: Only the workspace's validated server response is eligible. Edited input, failed runs or source changes remove the current-result association.
sourcePolicy.precision: Double-precision coordinates are visual approximations. Exact dyadic/rational values remain in the table and provenance inspector. Collapsed intervals are explicitly disclosed.
sourcePolicy.authority: No visualization upgrades proof status, resolves open obligations, or changes P7/M3 completion. Numerical source files remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

surface.desktop: Scene with adjacent inspector; exact table below
surface.mobile: Scene then inspector in a single column; wrap controls; no hover-only values
surface.urlState: p7 query parameter P7-01 through P7-08; invalid values restore P7-01; route remains #research-m3

renderer.library: Existing Three.js 0.180.0 import map and OrbitControls
renderer.coordinates: Each axis independently maps finite data coordinates to a bounded linear scene range; categories explicitly labeled
renderer.why3D: User-requested exploration of complex values, zero enclosures, multi-index operator/local data, rational point sequences and dependency layers
renderer.fallback: Exact accessible HTML table remains available when WebGL is unavailable; never overlay a second decorative renderer
renderer.lifecycle: Lazy initialization, render on demand, suspend and dispose when inactive, dispose replaced geometry, recover context failure with explicit retry
renderer.overflow: Disclose truncation; preserve original source access

interaction.selection: Canvas picking and keyboard/select alternatives synchronize inspector and marks
interaction.keyboard: Arrows, zoom keys, Home, item stepping; tabs use standard roving tabindex
interaction.permissions: No camera, microphone, sensor, location or notification permission
interaction.dataUpdate: Current result replaces only matching archive example; changing camera never mutates evidence
interaction.offline: Saved examples remain visibly labeled; current server connection state is separate

qa.pureModel: All eight criteria, authentic fixtures, null versus zero, nonfinite and extreme dyadic values, exact-source references, source immutability, no status promotion
qa.browser: Desktop and narrow layout; all tabs; current result and stale input; camera/selection/reset; route transitions; fallback and reduced motion; nonblank canvas and exact table
qa.review: Independent specialist checks interval semantics and open-claim preservation
qa.publication: Unique-anchor patch against current public version, preserve M2 script, verify live browser and archive evidence on GitHub
